title: Sub-sector reports · NSE 750
basis: Accord Fintech sector / sub-sector classification of the NSE 750

reports.name: Hospitals
reports.hook: How India’s private hospital chains turn a bed-day into profit: a 1.5-beds-per-thousand shortage, a contested fight over who sets the price, a 34,000-bed construction wave that dents margins first, and a market paying 25–40x EBITDA for mid-teens returns — with all 13 listed chains compared side by side.

reports.name: Auto Components
reports.hook: An industry that sells content, not cars: how 29 listed suppliers grow faster than vehicle production, which parts the EV transition deletes or multiplies, why US tariffs and China-made magnets and cells matter, and why the market pays ~46x while Denso gets ~15x.

reports.name: NBFCs
reports.hook: Specialist lenders on borrowed money: how 25 listed NBFCs turn wholesale funding into 2–8% returns on assets, why one 20% ROE trades at five times book and another at one, the gold-loan boom, the PFC–REC merger and the foreign money buying in.

reports.name: Civil Construction
reports.hook: Record order books, slow cash: how 22 listed EPC contractors turn a ₹14.9 lakh crore backlog into revenue, why roads slumped while transmission and solar boomed, why ₹100 of FY26 profit brought in only ₹29 of cash, and where L&T sits apart.

reports.name: Pharma – Branded Formulations
reports.hook: The doctor writes the brand, the state caps the price: how 13 listed branded-medicine makers grow on price, launches and chronic therapies, why field-force productivity and brand M&A decide the winners, and what price control, GLP-1s and MNC brand handovers change.

reports.name: Pharma – API & Intermediates
reports.hook: Buying from China, pricing against China, selling as the alternative to China: how 9 listed API makers live on the spread between drug-chemical prices and input costs, why PLI has barely dented imports, and how regulatory filings, fermentation and peptides lift some up the value chain.

reports.name: Pharma – Export Generic Formulations
reports.hook: Half the prescriptions, a tenth of the dollars: how 7 listed Indian exporters supply America's generic pills to three buyers who set the price, how a generic earns from filing to commodity, why FDA inspections gate growth, and the escape routes from price erosion.

reports.name: Pharma – Diversified Majors
reports.hook: The windfall ends, the engines must carry: how India's 6 multi-engine drugmakers combine India brands, US generics, specialty, EM and consumer in one P&L, the gRevlimid cliff, Sun's Organon leap, the GLP-1 race, and what the market pays for each engine.

reports.name: Pharma – CDMO / CMO
reports.hook: One label, five very different businesses: how India's 6 listed contract drug-makers earn from someone else's recipe, why lock-in makes revenue sticky yet lumpy, what BIOSECURE really changes, the GLP-1 supply layers, and why the market pays 22× to 73× EBITDA.

reports.name: Pharma – Specialty, Biologics & Innovation
reports.hook: Five bets priced on optionality, not earnings: biosimilars at scale (Biocon), India's first FDA-approved home-grown antibiotic (Wockhardt), first-to-file windfalls (NATCO), radiopharma (Jubilant) and pure discovery (SPARC) — how each earns, burns and is valued, and the one-off traps.

reports.name: Pharma – CRDMO
reports.hook: Renting scientists, chasing the molecule: why India's 3 listed CRDMOs shrank 10.6% while manufacturing CDMOs grew 25%, how a research client becomes a supply contract, the one-client problem (Librela, Anthem's top five), the narrowing India–China cost gap, and why the market pays 14× for one and 57× for another.

reports.name: Specialty Chem – Fluorochemicals
reports.hook: A toll gate on fluorine, priced by quota and by mix: how SRF, Gujarat Fluorochemicals and Navin turn fluorspar into refrigerants, Teflon, crop and drug molecules and battery salts — the Kigali capacity race to 2028, PFAS rules, contract chemistry, GFCL's battery bet and why the market pays 33× to 80×.

reports.name: Specialty Chem – Intermediates & Building Blocks
reports.hook: A spread business priced by China: how Deepak Nitrite, Aarti, Atul, Alkyl Amines, Balaji Amines and Laxmi Organic turn cheap feedstock into a margin, why Chinese overcapacity set it, the ₹5,400 Cr of unfinished plant from the capex super-cycle, and the limits of import substitution.

reports.name: Specialty Chem – Custom Synthesis & Life-science Intermediates
reports.subsector: Specialty Chem – Custom Synthesis & Life-science Intermediates
reports.hook: Sticky contracts, lumpy orders, rich multiples: how Acutaas, Anupam, Jubilant Ingrevia, Blue Jet, Aether and Neogen make molecules for global innovators, why one customer can swing a year, how working capital decides the return, the battery-chemicals bet against China, and why the market pays 31× to 214×.

reports.name: Private Sector Banks
reports.hook: The fight for the cheap rupee: how India's 19 listed private banks turn a ₹95 lakh crore deposit base into profit, HDFC Bank's post-merger loan-to-deposit squeeze, margins through the rate cycle, the end of the unsecured-loan cycle and the wave of foreign owners.

reports.name: Real Estate Developers
reports.hook: Homes peaked in 2023, the listed few kept winning: how 19 developers book pre-sales years before profit, why margin is made the day land is bought, what the 2026 plateau means, and how offices, malls and REITs became a second engine.
tags: Margin is made at land purchase

reports.name: IT Services
reports.hook: A ₹23.8 lakh crore bet on people, repriced for the age of AI: how 18 listed IT firms turn an engineer's hour into dollar revenue, GenAI deal deflation, the H-1B fee and client-owned GCCs, and why the rupee has been paying for flat margins.

reports.name: Cement
reports.hook: Two giants, a 70% ceiling and a fight over every tonne: how limestone becomes a ₹350 bag, why kilns run at seven-tenths of capacity, how UltraTech and Adani bought control, the regional price map, and the fuel and freight shock from West Asia.

reports.name: Industrial Products
reports.hook: Five businesses under one label, a valuation running ahead of its cash: contract electronics, process and cryogenic equipment, precision components, automation and mining consumables, and heavy fabrication — EMS margins, the airfoil bottleneck and ethanol's boom and bust.

reports.name: Power Generation
reports.hook: Cheap noon power, costly nights and a scramble for the evening peak: how 14 listed generators earn from coal, hydro, solar and wind, why firm power is the new scarcity, coal's second act, the delivery race, and storage as an asset class.
tags: Firm power is the new scarcity

reports.name: Iron & Steel
reports.hook: A spread business behind a porous trade wall: how 13 listed mills turn iron ore and imported coking coal into a margin set by Chinese export prices and the safeguard duty, captive mines, the race to 300 MTPA and the carbon costs arriving from Europe.

reports.name: Heavy Electrical Equipment
reports.hook: A scarcity boom meets its supply response: how India's grid and power-plant build-out turns into transformer, switchgear and turbine orders, why substations drove the cycle, the HVDC oligopoly, and how margins that tripled in three years could unwind.

reports.name: Other Electrical Equipment
reports.hook: Solar cells, wind turbines, transformers and Kavach — a policy rent that keeps moving: four businesses under one label, how long domestic-content cell rents last, China's price ceiling and America's closing door, and wind's localisation moat.

reports.name: Aerospace & Defence
reports.hook: A guaranteed customer, a factory waiting on engines: how India's defence budget becomes order books, Operation Sindoor's order surge, why imported engines and seekers decide how fast orders become sales, advances as float, and what 47× earnings assumes.

reports.name: Specialty Chem – Performance & Ingredient Chemicals
reports.hook: Small dose, big consequence: how Clean Science, Privi, Sudeep, Sudarshan and Advanced Enzymes sell what a chemical does rather than its tonnes — approval lock-in, inventory as the hidden cost, China's price ceiling, Privi's operating leverage and the Heubach turnaround test.
tags: Inventory is the price of specialty

reports.name: Public Sector Banks
reports.hook: Same profit as private banks, half the price: how India's 11 listed PSBs went from the NPA crisis to ₹1.97 lakh Cr of profit, why MCLR books reprice slowly, the government as owner (stake sales, IDBI), SBI's sum of the parts, and how clean the profit really is.

reports.name: Housing Finance Companies
reports.hook: One licence, three businesses, banks set the price: how prime and affordable HFCs reach the same ROE by opposite routes, why the 2025 rate cuts squeezed prime margins and the October hike reverses it, cracks in small-ticket loans, PE churn, and HUDCO as a fourth archetype.

reports.name: Compressors, Pumps & Diesel Engines
reports.hook: One label, three machines, two cycles: how Cummins, Kirloskar, Elgi, KSB, Shakti and peers earn from installed bases vs tenders — data-centre gensets and CPCB IV+, PM-KUSUM's end-game and the solar-pump bust, the Q1 FY27 margin squeeze, and MNC royalty creep.

reports.name: Gems, Jewellery & Watches
reports.hook: Dearer gold, fewer grams, bigger chains: how Titan, Kalyan, Senco and six peers grow while tonnage falls — the May-2026 duty jump to 15%, formalisation's land-grab, old-gold exchange, gold metal loans and hedging, the diamond price collapse, and how to strip one-offs from margins.

reports.name: Household Appliances
reports.hook: Hot summers, thin margins, foreign parents: how LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Crompton, Whirlpool and peers ride the AC weather cycle, why a hot 2026 still left margins capped, how MNC parents are cashing in on India, and why compressors became the chokepoint.

reports.name: Fertilizers
reports.hook: The state sets the price, then pays late: how Coromandel, Chambal, Paradeep, Deepak, RCF and peers live on subsidy — urea energy norms and NIPU-2026, the West Asia input shock, the coming P&K squeeze, profit without cash as the budget runs dry, and the chemicals windfall.

reports.name: Packaged Foods
reports.hook: Big brands up 20%, the market up 1%: how Nestlé, Britannia, Tata Consumer and five peers win share in a flat market — the commodity see-saw, GST 2.0 and the ₹10 pack, quick commerce rewiring distribution, Nestlé's royalty, and the de-rating measured against Haldiram's.

reports.name: Speciality Retail
reports.hook: The store machine meets its first test: how Trent, Lenskart, the Aditya Birla pair, Manyavar and two electronics chains turn square feet into profit — Zudio's slowing roll-out, the rent illusion in reported EBITDA, GST's ₹2,500 cliff, ABFRL's cash runway, and why P/Es run from 33× to 171×.

reports.name: Diversified Conglomerates
reports.hook: A premium for incubators, a discount for holders: how to value Adani Enterprises, Grasim, Godrej Industries, DCM Shriram, 3M India, Swan and RattanIndia — sum-of-the-parts and holdco discounts worked in ₹, Adani's incubator premium and legal overhang, governance as a price, and demergers as the unlock.

reports.name: Iron & Steel Products
reports.hook: The price moves, the spread stays: how APL Apollo, Welspun, Jindal SAW, Ratnamani, Usha Martin and peers earn a conversion margin on steel they buy — inventory gains and losses, APL's branded-tube franchise, the water-pipe air-pocket, Welspun inside the US tariff wall and the Hormuz shock.

reports.name: E-Retail & E-Commerce
reports.hook: The race to own the ten-minute basket: how Eternal, Swiggy, Meesho, Nykaa, FirstCry, Urban Company and Vaibhav Global make (or lose) money per order — the quick-commerce land-grab, food delivery as the profit pool, who may own inventory, Meesho's ₹265 basket, and EV per rupee of order value.

reports.name: Wealth & Other Financial Services
reports.hook: Four businesses, one ladder of multiples: how Bajaj Finserv, 360 ONE, Nuvama, Anand Rathi, Prudent, JM Financial and Edelweiss earn — recurring vs transactional fees, Bajaj Finserv's holdco discount decoded, SEBI's hand on the mutual-fund toll road, and the legacy lenders turning into fee houses.

reports.name: Hotels & Resorts
reports.hook: Scarce rooms, rich multiples, a widening split: how IHCL, ITC Hotels, EIH, Chalet, Leela, Lemon Tree and SAMHI turn room-nights into profit — the supply gap and its half-life, owner vs operator economics, palaces up and midscale squeezed by the ₹7,500 GST cliff, and the listing and deal wave.

reports.name: Personal Care
reports.hook: The market shrank, the brands grew: how Marico, Godrej Consumer, Dabur, Colgate, Gillette, Emami and Honasa took share in falling volumes — the copra and West Asia cost cycles, GST 2.0 passed on as MRP cuts, digital-first brands meeting the kirana, and why the MNCs now trade at a discount.
tags: The price of a dried coconut

reports.name: Software Products
reports.hook: One cash machine, six strivers: how OFSS, Intellect, Newgen, MapmyIndia, RateGain, Aurionpro and Capillary earn from IP — the vanished product premium outside OFSS, lumpy licences, the licence-to-SaaS transition, growth bought abroad, cash-quality flags and the 2026 de-rating.

reports.name: Industrial Plastic Products
reports.hook: One resin, five very different businesses: how Supreme, Astral, Finolex, Garware, Shaily, Time Technoplast and EPL earn — the April PVC whipsaw, policy moving from duty to a price floor, Finolex's resin integration, Shaily's GLP-1 pens, Garware's film boom and the deal wave.

reports.name: Textiles & Home Textiles
reports.hook: Five businesses, one tariff, one fibre: how KPR Mill, Vardhman, Welspun Living, Trident, Arvind, Indo Count and Alok earn — the US tariff roller-coaster from 50% to a 10% Section 301 duty, the UK and EU deals, the cotton paradox and yarn spreads, and the integration premium.

reports.name: Refineries & Marketing
reports.hook: The world sets the margin, Delhi the price: how Reliance, IOC, BPCL, HPCL, MRPL and Chennai Petroleum earn — the 2026 war split that sank the state marketers while refiners profited, the five pricing levers, Russian crude and Hormuz, the capacity wave, and why the PSUs trade at under 5× earnings.

reports.name: Life Insurance
reports.hook: Who keeps the margin, insurer or bank? How LIC, SBI Life, HDFC Life, ICICI Pru, Axis Max and Canara HSBC create value — APE, VNB and embedded value explained, IRDAI's proposed commission and expense caps, the 2023–26 rule and tax reset, and LIC's valuation paradox at 0.63× EV.

reports.name: Two & Three Wheelers
reports.hook: One record year, two diverging markets: how Bajaj, Eicher, TVS, Hero, Ather and Ola fare as GST cuts and the fuel shock split scooters from motorcycles — the EV shake-out the incumbents won, premiumisation and the 350cc cliff, exports as a second engine, and valuations from 12× to 56×.

reports.name: Paints & Adhesives
reports.hook: The moat that money tried to buy: how Asian Paints, Pidilite, Berger, JSW Dulux, Kansai Nerolac and Indigo fare as Birla Opus turns an oligopoly into a trade-spend war — the volume–value gap that flipped on costs, the capacity glut, Asian Paints' counter-attack and Pidilite's untouched moat.

reports.name: Asset Management Companies
reports.hook: Record flows, falling prices, a fee fight: how HDFC, ICICI Pru, Nippon, ABSL, UTI and Canara Robeco AMCs earn a toll on India's savings — who paid for SEBI's fee reset, the equity-share race, AUM that pays vs AUM that doesn't, and what the SBI Funds listing did to valuations.
tags: Who paid for SEBI's fee reset?

reports.name: Cables & Wires
reports.hook: Selling copper by the metre, at a premium: how six listed makers turn record copper into 26% revenue growth on single-digit volumes, why UltraTech's and Adani's entry cost multiples rather than earnings, the climb up the voltage ladder and FMEG's long-awaited turn.

reports.name: Stockbroking & Capital-Market Intermediaries
reports.hook: A toll on speculation, being narrowed: how six listed brokers earn from F&O orders, margin lending and fees, why SEBI's curbs and the 2026 STT hike cut traders but not premium, Groww's 29% share, the MTF boom and why valuations run from 11× to 72×.

reports.name: Investment & Holding Companies
reports.hook: The discount is the asset class: how six listed holdcos turn stakes in Bajaj, Tata, Lloyds and TVS-family companies into NAV, why Bajaj Holdings trades 46% below what it owns, Tata Investment's lost premium, and the regulator-led catalysts that close discounts.

reports.name: Breweries & Distilleries
reports.hook: The state takes more than the brand: how six listed drinks makers earn after excise that exceeds their own revenue, Maharashtra's and Karnataka's tax resets, premiumisation and Indian single malts, Scotch after the UK FTA, the grain-to-glass squeeze and the RCB sale.

reports.name: General Insurance
reports.hook: Losing on risk, earning on the float: how six listed general insurers turn a ₹3.36 lakh Cr premium pool and a 113% combined ratio into profit, health's rise after the GST cut, motor's frozen tariffs, the PSU float problem and IRDAI's commission reset.

reports.name: Consumer Electronics & EMS
reports.hook: India's policy-built factory, plus two brands: how four contract manufacturers and two branded players turn PLI, MPMS and ECMS into revenue, the climb out of 3% margins, 2026's memory-chip shock, Chinese JVs under Press Note 3 and Dixon's hidden CP PLUS gain.

reports.name: Engineering R&D Services
reports.hook: Engineering hours in an auto air-pocket: how six listed ER&D firms sell engineers to carmakers, planemakers and chip designers, why profits fell 15% as European auto and JLR stalled, who keeps the GenAI gains, GCCs as rival and customer, and the great de-rating.

reports.name: Pesticides & Agrochemicals
reports.hook: Two industries, one label, one crash: how six listed agrochem makers turn molecules into branded packs, generic exports and custom synthesis, why the FY24 profit collapse was almost all UPL, China's price floor, a weak 2026 monsoon, PI's patent down-cycle and working capital as the quality test.

reports.name: Commodity Chemicals
reports.hook: Three chemistries, one Chinese price problem: how six listed makers of soda ash, bromine, polystyrene, ABS and bio-glycols earn a spread, why Inner Mongolia's natural soda ash broke the world price, why November's safeguard ruling matters, and how styrenics boomed while soda ash bust.

reports.name: Commercial Vehicles
reports.hook: Record volumes, squeezed truckers: how five listed CV makers turn steel into trucks, buses and pickups, why margins fell while FY26 sales broke the FY19 record, the trucker's diesel-versus-freight P&L as the cycle signal, a Tata-led oligopoly, and why e-bus tenders went to capital, not incumbents.
